description: Products of one store like the store website lists them: by category, tag or brand, with size/color filters, price range in BRL, only in stock, only on sale or featured, sorted by newest, price, best sellers or ending offers. The first page also brings the filters available (sizes, colors, brands, categories, price range) and the total. 20 per page.

featured.description: Only the featured products of the home page.

filters.description: Attribute filters from filters.attributes: {"tamanho": "p,m", "cor": "preto"} (attribute slug => value slugs).

on_sale.description: Only products with a current promotion.

sort.description: Order; without it, the store order.

store.description: Store id ("store" field from find_store or search_products).

name: browse_products
title: Browse store products
